Subject: Brand mention & logo use — MSA/Order Form redlines

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Attaching a redline of the MSA and the draft Order Form with the publicity sections highlighted. Our legal team flagged two items we want to align on before we proceed to signature:

1) Embargo window: AcroSoft mentioned a soft embargo until product GA. Can you confirm a target date or whether you prefer a relative window (e.g., x days after public launch)?

2) Logo and reference rights: Our standard language asks for a non-exclusive, perpetual right to use customer logos and a short customer quote in marketing collateral, subject to a one-review approval. If AcroSoft needs carveouts (channels, product names, or geography), please indicate specifics.

3) Confidentiality carveouts: We typically allow anonymized benchmarks to be published with prior approval. If AcroSoft requires additional redactions, call them out.

Next steps: if you can send a redline of the publicity clause and any internal approval steps (legal + comms), we’ll loop in our product marketing to get approved asset specs and an embargo schedule.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx, OrderForm_ProspectCo_redline.pdf

Best,

Subject: Re: Brand mention & logo use — MSA/Order Form redlines

Kimberly —

Thanks for sending these over. I’ve attached AcroSoft’s redline (AcroSoft_redlines.docx) with comments on the publicity and confidentiality sections. High level:

- Embargo: we’ll need an embargo until May 1, 2028 (product announcement). We can accept a relative window only if it is tied to our public announcement.
- Logo use: OK for logo in case studies, product pages and joint press releases after written approval from our comms team. No use in paid ads or reseller materials without an additional license.
- Reference rights: we’re comfortable with a short, pre-approved quote but require that AcroSoft sign off on the quote wording.
- Confidentiality: AcroSoft will allow anonymized performance benchmarks provided no customer-identifying metrics are included; we want to review the exact data excerpts before publication.

I’ve marked language we prefer in the MSA that limits publicity to defined channels and requires a two-step approval (legal + comms). Please review and let me know if Redwood can accept those constraints.

Looping you both in — Emma sent AcroSoft’s redline with a firm May 1 embargo and restrictions on channels and paid use. Key asks for legal review:

- Can we accept the embargo tied to their announcement (May 1)? I think yes but we should preserve a short exception for product updates required for compliance or regulatory notices.
- They want to review any benchmark excerpts; propose we accept review but limit review to 7 business days and allow anonymized metrics otherwise.
- Logo scope: case study, product page, and joint press — they prohibit paid/reseller. Can we adopt a narrower license that still covers our GTM (docs, website, one case study)?

I’ve attached our current redline (Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx) and the Order Form. Monica — can you flag which marketing materials we absolutely need?

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Brand mention & logo use — AcroSoft redlines

Kim / Monica —

Quick notes after reviewing AcroSoft_redlines.docx:

- Embargo: Accept May 1, 2028 as the hard date. Add fallback language: "In the event of a regulatory requirement or security incident that necessitates earlier disclosure, Redwood may publish privately targeted communications after notifying AcroSoft." Keeps risk low and preserves operational needs.

- Review periods: Change their open-ended review to "7 business days from notice" and if no response, approval is deemed granted. For benchmark data, add scope: "high-level metrics only (latency/throughput/accuracy) with no PII, revenue, or customer identifiers."

- Logo/license scope: Proposed compromise — allow one (1) case study, one (1) short quote (<60 words), and logo use on a Redwood product page and in a joint press release. Explicitly exclude paid advertising and reseller collateral. Require AcroSoft’s logo guidelines file be used.

- Contract language suggestion (we can paste into the MSA):
> Publicity: Customer grants Redwood the right to use Customer's name, logo and a short approved quote in marketing materials limited to case studies, product pages and joint press releases. All uses subject to Customer's written approval (which shall not be unreasonably withheld) and a 7-business-day review period. Embargo to May 1, 2028.

I’ve attached a short Exhibit with an embargo calendar template — MSA-Exhibit-Press-Schedule.xlsx. If marketing confirms we only need the items above, I’m comfortable signing off and sending the revised redline back to Emma for final approval.

- Next: Monica, can you confirm the asset types (web hero, one-page case study PDF, 1–2 images) so we can ask AcroSoft for the exact file specs and logo kit.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Final proposed language — publicity & confidentiality (MSA + Order Form)

Emma —

Thanks for the redline and for the clarity on the embargo. After internal review we can accept AcroSoft’s May 1, 2028 embargo with the following, limited edits (summarized):

1) Embargo exception: we added a narrow exception for regulatory/security disclosures with prior notice.
2) Review timelines: AcroSoft will have 7 business days to review any proposed quote or excerpt; if no response, approval will be deemed granted.
3) Benchmark scope: Agreement allows anonymized, high-level performance metrics only (no revenue or customer identifiers). Redwood will provide excerpts for review consistent with the 7-business-day timeline.
4) Logo & quote scope: Redwood requests allowance for one case study, a short quote (<= 60 words) and logo placement on a Redwood product page and in a joint press release. We accept AcroSoft’s restriction on paid ads and reseller materials.

We’ve prepared a consolidated redline with the edits above and a short Exhibit capturing the embargo calendar. I can upload via DocuSign if that works for you — please send the envelope link (or we can accept your DocuSign).

Requested next steps:
- Emma / Alex: confirm you’re good with the 7-business-day review and the scope for benchmarks and logo use.
- If yes, please provide the final DocuSign envelope (or confirm we should send).
- Monica: once approved, please request logo files and brand guidelines from Alex so we can prep the case study assets.

Thanks — we’re aiming to have the signed MSA + Order Form in place before your May announcement.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
